title: Transfer Fee Tariff of the Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
A transfer out of a Keyturn Host Payout Account carries the fee its schedule sets for the way the money is sent. The tariff below states every such fee, together with the number of returned transfers a schedule tolerates in a rolling year.

## Tariff

| Payout schedule | Instant transfer fee | Instant fee floor | Instant fee ceiling | Express flat fee | Wire fee | Cheque fee | Debit card push fee | Currency conversion fee | Returned transfer fee | Returns before suspension |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 8.00 USD | 0 percent | 2.5 percent | 15.00 USD | 3 |
| Weekly Batch | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 8.00 USD | 0 percent | 2.5 percent | 15.00 USD | 3 |
| Express | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 2.50 USD | 20.00 USD | 8.00 USD | 1 percent | 2 percent | 15.00 USD | 3 |
| Instant | 1.5 percent | 0.50 USD | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 20.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 1.5 percent | 2 percent | 20.00 USD | 2 |
| Fleet Settlement | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 0 percent | 1.5 percent | 25.00 USD | 2 |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 0 percent | 1.25 percent | 25.00 USD | 2 |

## What each column charges for

The **instant transfer fee** is taken as a percentage of the sum moved, and is never less than the **instant fee floor** nor more than the **instant fee ceiling**. The **express flat fee** is a flat sum for an express transfer. The **wire fee** and the **cheque fee** are flat sums for sending money by wire and by cheque. The **debit card push fee** is a percentage of the sum pushed to a debit card, and the **currency conversion fee** a percentage of the sum converted. The **returned transfer fee** is charged when a transfer comes back unpaid. **Returns before suspension** is the number of returned transfers in a rolling year after which the account is suspended.

## Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical instant transfer of 1000.00 USD on the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule. The fee at 1.5 percent of the sum moved comes to 15.00 USD, which sits above the 0.50 USD floor and below the 45.00 USD ceiling, so 15.00 USD is the fee. On a hypothetical instant transfer of 10.00 USD on the same schedule the percentage gives 0.15 USD, which falls under the floor, so the floor of 0.50 USD is charged instead; on a hypothetical instant transfer of 6000.00 USD the percentage gives 90.00 USD, which stands above the ceiling, so 45.00 USD is charged.
